content:
We have IR spectrum with a peak at 1707 cm-1, typical carbonyl stretch. Need number of C=O groups. Could be more than one but only one strong carbonyl peak. However sometimes overlapping. The IR shows only one carbonyl region peak. Likely one carbonyl group.

But we could also check carbon NMR for carbonyl carbons (around 190-210 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra.
